key_highlights: ASX treading water amid looming interest rate fears, offset by Wall Street surge and $154b Paramount-Warner Bros merger clearance
RBA Governor Bullock's hawkish stance reinforces 'higher for longer' rate narrative; Wall Street braces for further Fed hikes
Iron ore downside persists, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; fuel shock (diesel/petrol) adds inflationary pressure
Sydney housing market in 'bloodbath' as auction activity cools; Bragg reignites super-housing policy fight
Active gold exploration across WA/SA (Platina, Broken Hill, Forrestania, Great Southern, Larvotto) signals sector rotation into precious metals
Super contributions surge >33% post-budget tax changes; new government-backed digital pension scheme proposed as parallel to compulsory super
China economic cracks under Xi raise demand concerns for Australian commodity exporters
ASIC sues former Super Retail Group boss for market misconduct; corporate governance scrutiny intensifies

sectors.trend: Iron ore faces sustained downside pressure amid China demand weakness; gold sector sees multiple positive exploration results across WA and SA, driving a precious-metals rotation
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX under pressure from iron ore softness; gold miners (BHG.AX, PLT.AX, FRT.AX, GSO.AX, LRV.AX) attract speculative and fundamental interest; rare earths (DAR.AX) gain strategic relevance

sectors.trend: Hawkish RBA (Bullock) and Fed rate-hike fears support net interest margins but weigh on credit growth; housing stress in Sydney raises NPL concerns
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from elevated rates but face housing-linked credit risk; Super Retail Group (SRE.AX) faces ASIC litigation overhang

sectors.trend: Diesel and petrol price shock rising, adding to input-cost inflation; Victoria's data centre strategy with renewables requirements signals structural energy demand growth
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX face margin pressure from fuel costs; renewable/infrastructure names benefit from data centre build-out

sectors.trend: Sydney housing 'bloodbath' and cooling auction market pressure property valuations; younger Australians face tough economic outlook; rental market disruption proposed
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face rental yield compression; consumer discretionary (WES.AX, WOW.AX) under pressure from cost-of-living stress

sectors.trend: Cold/flu supplement recall (controversial herb) creates short-term disruption; Meta AI agent and China AI developments signal global tech momentum; aged care funding delays persist
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX (pharma) see mixed signals; tech exposure via global indices; aged care operators face policy uncertainty

sectors.trend: Super contributions surge >33% post-budget; Bragg links super to housing; new government-backed digital pension scheme proposed as parallel track
sectors.implications: Super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPA.AX, QAN.AX) see AUM tailwinds; policy debate could reshape compulsory super architecture long-term

Commodity bifurcation: iron ore weak vs gold/rare earths strong
Housing market correction in Sydney with policy response (super-housing link, auction reality check)
China demand fragility threatening Australian export earnings
Super/pension policy overhaul: surging contributions, digital pension proposal, housing linkage
Fuel price shock adding inflationary pressure
Corporate governance: ASIC enforcement action against Super Retail Group
Demographics: migration debate, falling birth rate, baby bonus discussion

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Interest rate shock / RBA-Fed hawkish pivot
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge duration risk; favour floating-rate and short-duration credit; maintain cash buffers
Reduce exposure to pure iron ore names; diversify into gold and critical minerals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Sydney housing market correction spilling into credit losses
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor bank NPL trends; underweight high-LVR REITs; favour defensive financials
Favour energy producers and inflation-linked assets; avoid high-input-cost consumer names
Maintain diversified global exposure; hold AUD-hedged positions; monitor commodity hedges
Monitor legislative progress on digital pension scheme; assess impact on super fund AUM flows

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and critical minerals on iron ore rotation
opportunities.rationale: Multiple positive WA/SA gold results (10.72g/t Great Southern, Broken Hill sulphides, Platina, Forrestania) plus rare earths (Dalaroo) signal sector momentum; iron ore weakness creates relative value

opportunities.recommendation: Favour bank NIM beneficiaries with credit hedges
opportunities.rationale: Hawkish RBA supports margins but Sydney housing stress warrants selective positioning; CBA and NAB show stronger balance sheets
>33% contribution surge post-budget plus digital pension proposal expand addressable market for fund managers

opportunities.recommendation: Buy the dip in global tech/aviation on Fed scare
opportunities.rationale: Wall Street surge and BofA buy call on aviation suggest oversold conditions; Meta AI agent adds catalyst

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce pure iron ore and China-exposed materials
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore downside persists amid China cracks; trade war risk (Trump) amplifies demand uncertainty

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight Sydney-exposed REITs and high-LVR property
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing 'bloodbath' and auction reality check signal falling valuations and rising vacancy risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge fuel-cost inflation in consumer staples
defensive_moves.rationale: Diesel/petrol shock rising; input costs squeeze margins for WES, WOW, and transport names

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash and short-duration bonds as rate uncertainty persists
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA hawkish, Fed hike fears, 'higher rates new normal' narrative create volatility; preserve capital

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to range-trade with elevated volatility. Wall Street strength provides a floor, but RBA hawkishness, Fed hike fears, iron ore weakness, and Sydney housing stress cap upside. Gold and critical minerals outperform; banks mixed; REITs and consumer under pressure. Expect 1-2% index volatility over coming weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from higher-for-longer rates, China demand fragility, and housing correction weigh on 6-12 month outlook. However, gold/critical minerals super-cycle, super AUM growth, and data centre/renewables build-out provide sector-specific tailwinds. ASX 200 likely to consolidate in a 8,200-8,800 range before next RBA decision.
